subject: executor, sessiontxn/isolation: fix max_execution_time to include TSO wait time (#64408)
summary: Adjusts `ExecStmt.Exec` to record an execution start timestamp before `buildExecutor()` and use it when updating session ProcessInfo, so `max_execution_time` (and any ProcessInfo.Time-based enforcement) accounts for time spent waiting on TSO/txn activation during executor build. Adds a failpoint hook in `baseTxnContextProvider.ActivateTxn()` plus a unit test to validate the accounting. No remaining Blocker/High issues found relative to first parent; no later upstream/master fixes required.
